name: Diamantsturm
description:
You stir up a massive storm of sharp diamonds in a {shape}, centered on a point in range. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it takes {dice} {type} damage.

You do not take damage from the storm. For as long as you are in the storm's cylinder, your have +2 to AC.

updated.details: Shape changed to cylinder. User no longer takes damage from the storm. AC bonus always granted.
